rows.threshold: exactly one authorization; the sha256 of the file found in the workspace (computed by the scorer, not the runtime) == the authorization content_sha256 == S5 content_sha256 == S5 disk_sha256 == the S3 proposal content sha256; the file path == the task destination

rows.criterion: Complete document saved (no truncation at embedded fences)
rows.threshold: the file is read; its fence lines (``` or ~~~ at line start) are even in number and at least 2 x min_code_blocks; when min_code_blocks > 0 the text after the last fence line has at least min_tail_words words and, if tail_heading is set, a line equal to it; the saved text equals the document an independent reading takes from the accepted reply (outer fence stripped, trailing whitespace ignored)

rows.criterion: Stated requirements met (outcome of the saved bytes)
rows.threshold: the file saved at the destination exists and meets every requirement declared for the task, counted by the campaign tooling on the saved text by the requirements.rs rules (non-empty lines including fence lines; markdown headings outside fenced code; each declared title present as a heading); nothing saved = FAIL; whether the runtime recognized the requirement does not matter

at least one attempt; the attempts total ms <= the task budget_ms (edit 29000, document 120000); no attempt reason contains "exceeded" (the wall-clock timeout wording); an accepted (parsed) attempt exists
